description: Guardrail 8: 'A consume without a matching provider ... is an error, not a warning. Do not ship a map with any of these unresolved.' Guards against /rush-features shipping a map where a feature consumes an interface no other feature provides.

given.scenario: Fixture specs/integration-map.md where 003-checkout consumes 'POST /payments/charge' without a 'from' provider — the same map used by the rush-spec eval suite's gate case, reused here because both agents depend on this validator catching it.
